related.title: 龍羊峽水光互補電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；龍羊峽水光互補電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Longyangxia Hydro–Solar Complementary Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦寒冷沙漠裡的光電園區：草方格固沙、低溫下的組串電壓、限電與特高壓外送；龍羊峽水光互補電站則以光電與水電合成一部機組：水庫當電池、高海拔的空氣密度與爬坡補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A solar park in a cold desert: straw checkerboards against sand, string voltage in the cold, curtailment and UHV export; Longyangxia Hydro–Solar Complementary Plant centres on solar and hydro combined as one unit: the reservoir as battery, air density at altitude and ramp compensation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「組串設計與低溫開路電壓」的模型移到龍羊峽水光互補電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雲遮時的爬坡補償」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "String design and cold open-circuit voltage" to Longyangxia Hydro–Solar Complementary Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ramp compensation when clouds pass", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；龍羊峽水光互補電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Longyangxia Hydro–Solar Complementary Plant must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A solar park in a cold desert: straw checkerboards against sand, string voltage in the cold, curtailment and UHV export; Benban Solar Park centres on A multi-developer solar park in the desert: the plot model, 220 kV evacuation and water for cleaning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「組串設計與低溫開路電壓」的模型移到班班太陽能園區，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「I–V 曲線與填充因子」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "String design and cold open-circuit voltage" to Benban Solar Park, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "I–V curve and fill factor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；班班太陽能園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Benban Solar Park must be respecified.

history.title: 騰格里沙漠太陽能園區
history.text: 1950 年中衛開始以草方格防治鐵路沿線的流沙；2015 年園區開始大規模建設；2017 年裝置容量達到約 150 萬 kW；2023 年鄰近的 300 萬 kW 基地開工。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1950: Zhongwei began using straw checkerboards against sand along the railway. 2015: Large-scale construction of the park began. 2017: Capacity reached about 1.5 GW. 2023: The nearby 3 GW base started construction. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
